registered_scientific_inputs.finding: Current FRANK requirement surface demands versioned state, provenance/tier, open-set outcomes, promotion/rollback, resource budgets and replay; no dedicated visual-learning syntax is justified yet because generic G9 state/provenance/delta/recovery constructs can represent the contract in principle.

ClayCode is the semantic origin of dependency/effect/authority/provenance/hyperposition/invalidation signatures; frontend closure is therefore a cross-system prerequisite rather than cosmetic syntax work.

Versioned node/edge/hyperrelation identity, typed roles, activation, projection/selection/receiver receipts and invalidation can map to G9 records/deltas; activation remains non-authoritative. Current parser closure, not a missing graph semantic primitive, is the immediate blocker found in this run.

Epochs, semantic transactions, idempotency, authority scope, query receipts, evidence and claim refs align with existing G9 records. No evidence in this run requires physical store unification or new ClayCode syntax.

GWT requires explicit selection/broadcast/delivery/use/outcome/re-entry distinctions and typed causal receipts; G9 already models these distinctions, but the admitted surface must be parseable before H2 can differentially execute them.

Higher-order relations, roles, alternatives and topology/readout requirements are present in current candidates. The dynamic-binding candidate itself exposes grammar-closure counterexamples through comparison operators and research-meta declarations.
Interventions, nulls, lesion/rescue, shuffled re-entry and vector readouts remain data/measurement semantics, not execution authority. No new emergence syntax is required by evidence from this run.
H-WP-03 and H-WP-18 are explicitly blocked on ClayCode release, so parser/compiler closure is directly on the staged critical path.

BASE remains NOT_PASS with all release work packages open. Current admitted G9 artifacts use constructs absent from grammar.ebnf; this run isolates a frontend closure gap and a minimal repair path without semantic reinvention.

historical_lineage.finding: Project-Frankenstein already accumulated multiple tolerant tool-tag parser fallbacks and hallucination-specific aliases. This is active negative design knowledge: ClayCode should prefer one frozen grammar plus deterministic diagnostics/canonicalization instead of growing permissive hidden parse heuristics.
